description: PROBE 1 (audit 2026-07-11 §3.A): Habiro-integrality kill-test of the Q_β precision ladder. Symbolically Taylor-expands L(q) = Π_{k=2..5}(1+c_k·u^k), u = b(q)·ℏ_q², in h = q−1 over ℚ(√3)[c_3,c_4,c_5] (exact sympy series), plugs c_2 = −1 (PROVED) + per-anchor empirical c_3 (full-absorption extraction at proton and muon q₀ pins), and tests Habiro integrality (Z[[q−1]], secondary Z[√3] = O_{Q(√3)}) of the coefficients against propagated uncertainty (σ_exp(Q_β) = 780 ppb; anchor systematic). Normalizations: (a) bare L; (b) P·L with the q-dependent dimensionless prefactor P = (Q_base/m_e) = |q²−2q−1|(q+1)/(2q³)·cos(α−u/2); (c) h ↔ ℏ_q basis invariance VERIFIED symbolically. No fitted forms; no c_k value proposals (flip-flop guard).
auditOnly: Hypothesis-class test (not a c_k derivation); not in refuted classes C1–C14.
